Earlier this morning, Minister of Agriculture, [Han Changfu](http://file.agrogene.cn/upload/2013/12/6/2592.jpg), made an update on the official [Chinese Ministry of Agriculture website](http://english.agri.gov.cn/). In it, he thanked the administrator of the China National Space Administration, [Xu Dazhe](http://www.apsco.int/apsco-ad/imapic/20151141574141173.jpg), for having both the Ministry of Agriculture and the Chinese National Space Agency come together to detail a new project that is under development.

The project is described as "the future of indoor farming", taking everything that the two entities currently know about indoor farming, and breaking the limits. The building will be a decent sized [25 sq m in size](http://cebuphilippinescondominiums.weebly.com/uploads/6/7/0/8/6708881/27105_orig.png), allowing for plenty of devices to be built inside. On each of the sides, [rows of stacked planters](http://cebuphilippinescondominiums.weebly.com/uploads/6/7/0/8/6708881/27105_orig.png) will be firmly secured into the building, in the event anything is to suddenly and/or violently move the building. The building will have two metal sliding bars on the roof in the center isle, between the two rows of planters. These bars will hold the [robotic hands](http://space.alglobus.net/Kalpana/Kalpana-farm-7a-1920.jpg) that will harvest grown plants. The Chinese National Space Administration has made a list of various other features for the building.

#Building Outside

* Secure airlock, keeping the inside a constant pressure, humidity, and temperature.

* [High efficiency 3D solar cells coating the building, leading into a storage bank and controls to convert and direct it.](http://www.solar3d.com/technology.php)

* Ability to withstand small meteor impacts, being bolted down deep into the ground for bigger impacts.

#Building Inside

* [Stable relative humidity of 50%](http://home.howstuffworks.com/how-to-care-for-house-plants3.htm).

* [Constant temperature of 25°C](http://api.ning.com/files/-lcw-RpPXUNEhcw8pIYDESbkCUqi8J1x6ZjAWlnQSjJsFMofT3Onti3h88ayBPZy4Rs0dfgxZ-M8nav*AjGbp3zPbe0dwVMO/temperaturelores.jpg).

* Carbon Dioxide and Oxygen filtration system, putting CO2 inside, and O2 into another space or storage container.

* [Pure water production from Hydrogen and Oxygen](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cN0-xJ59gKI).

#Planters

* Daily water misting of plants from above.

* [18 Hours of full-spectrum fluorescent bulbs, and 6 Hours of darkness](http://www.gardeners.com/how-to/gardening-under-lights/5080.html) (Sans necessary lights in order for humans to see where they are going, and for robot hands to see what they are harvesting).

#Robotic Hands

* 360° rotation, allowing for plants growing in weird ways to be harvested.

The building will be built on the [outskirts of Turpan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turpan), in the desert land. The project is estimated to take a year to be profesionally built. It will run for a year, and after that, the results of it will be gathered. It is expected to cost around 100 Million to make sure everything is perfect for the most optimal results to come through.

The Minister of Agriculture of Russia, Alexander Nikolayevich Tkachyov, has picked up this news and is very interested in these development. He made a call to the Ministry of foreign affairs to ensure the upcoming diplomatic mission to china will discuss some kind of cooperation on agricultural level.
